thread:
Sarah (Partnerships): Quick kick-off: we need AWS/GCP/Azure staging entries ready for partner review next week. Primary asks: sandbox accounts, legal checklist, SKU copy, and marketing assets. Who can own which?
Tony (Cloud Ops): I can provision sandboxes. Need account IDs and expected cross-account role ARNs. Will tag once ready.
Elena (PM): I'll do SKU copy + two-line marketing blurb. Preference: one SKU per cloud, trial 14d, BYO billing disabled.
Raj (Eng): For integration: we'll expose a webhook endpoint for marketplace callbacks and a small healthcheck route. Which auth method do we want?
Lisa (Legal): On legal: we require signed publisher agreement or marketplace terms, privacy URL, export controls confirmation, and a logo usage release. I can assemble a checklist doc and share a secure folder.
marketplace-bot: Staging template created: AWS: acct-222333444555 (role: Redwood-Market-Installer), GCP: project-redwood-stg-2024 (svc acct created), Azure: subscription-stub-01. Links: https://console.internal/sandbox/222333444555
Tony (Cloud Ops): Pushed a skeleton IAM trust and role naming conv to the ops repo. I'll attach role ARNs shortly. Question: telemetry webhook should accept HMAC header or OAuth? HMAC preferred for speed.
Raj (Eng): HMAC works. We'll sign payloads with sha256 and include X-RW-Signature header. Sample payload and verification snippet incoming.
Elena (PM): Draft name: "Redwood Inference — Cloud Starter". Blurb: "Managed low-latency LLM inference with cost controls and SLA options." Pricing tiers: Starter / Growth / Enterprise. I'll post the short SKU table in the doc.
Lisa (Legal): That name ok. Add legal contact: legal+marketplace@redwood.com. I'll add a privacy sentence: "We do not log user prompt content; telemetry excludes PII."
Sarah (Partnerships): Assets needed: 1200x628 PNG hero, SVG logo, 2 short demo gifs, 150-250 word product description. @Elena can you own creative coordination?
Elena (PM): Yep. I'll ping design and get drafts by Wed EOD.
Tony (Cloud Ops): Note for AWS: please ensure the role includes sts:AssumeRole and a read-only listing policy. Example trust JSON posted in the repo. Also enabling cross-account CloudWatch logs streaming to our logging account.
Raj (Eng): We'll stub webhook receiver and add verification example in Node/Python. Also flagging that the marketplace can call out license checks, so include a minimal license check endpoint.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: upload legal-templates/v3 to shared drive.
Lisa (Legal): Will prepare signing flow and redline window. Expect initial checklist by tomorrow.
Sarah (Partnerships): OK owners/ETAs: Tony: sandboxes + ARNs (ETA: today 6pm). Raj: webhook + samples (ETA: tomorrow noon). Elena: SKU copy + assets coord (ETA: Wed EOD). Lisa: legal checklist + signoff path (ETA: tomorrow EOD). I'll run a preflight on Thu 9am.
Tony (Cloud Ops): 6pm works.
Raj (Eng): Noted. Will sanitize telemetry and include example scrub rules.
Elena (PM): I'll include the trial UX notes (auto-convert to paid after trial unless canceled).
Sarah (Partnerships): Great. If anyone hits blockers, drop them in the doc and ping me. Planning a short review Thu 9am. :calendar:
Tony (Cloud Ops): One more item: confirm if we should enable auto-rotate for marketplace creds. Ops prefers yes.
Lisa (Legal): Auto-rotate fine, document rotation schedule in the checklist.
Sarah (Partnerships): Thanks all
